verdict.rationale: Notte ships its own web agents that take natural-language tasks and act on the user's behalf: 'Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt.' and the agent-start API 'run web ai agents to act on your behalf'. This is the product's own delegation capability, not an external tool. Coverage is still partial: delegation is limited to browser and web tasks, it is exposed mainly through the API/SDK, and the evidence never documents an in-product assistant interface. One hands-on report says an extraction task 'completely failed', which lowers confidence in reliability. missing for 10: documented built-in assistant UI inside the product, delegation beyond web/browser tasks, independent corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt. No selectors, no maintenance.
